goalTextEn: Can talk about simple future plans and availability.
goalTextKr: 간단한 예정과 가용 시간에 대해 말할 수 있다.

introduce.goalEn: Can talk about simple future plans and availability.
introduce.goalKr: 간단한 예정과 가용 시간에 대해 말할 수 있다.
introduce.situationEn: A coworker wants to have lunch together. You check your schedule.
introduce.situationKr: 동료가 함께 점심을 먹자고 합니다. 당신은 일정을 확인합니다.

tutorNotes.text: "Today, we will practice can talk about simple future plans and availability.."
Read the lesson goal aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
"Is it clear?"
Read the situation. Check the student understands.
"Let's go to the next part."
Keep the pace steady. Encourage full sentences.

vocabulary.definition: able to do something at a certain time

tutorNotes.text: "Let's learn the key patterns for today."
Read each pattern aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
Teach vocabulary with short examples.
"Now, let's practice pronunciation."
Correct only 1-2 key issues each round.

understand.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct pattern. Then practice the pattern drills.
understand.instructionKr: 빈칸에 올바른 표현을 넣으고 패턴 드릴을 연습하세요.

patternDrills.label: Sharing your schedule
patternDrills.template: I have ___ at ___. / I am available after ___.

examples.en: I have a meeting at 1 PM.

tutorNotes.text: Do the fill-in-the-blank first.
Run drills with substitutions and faster pace in the second round.
If stuck, give the first word or time as a hint.

steps.title: Step 1 - Repeat After Me
steps.content:
1. Are you free on Wednesday?
2. I have a meeting at 1 PM.
3. Sorry, I'm busy on Friday.
4. I am available after 2.
5. How about next week?
6. Let's set a time.

tutorNotes.text: Read each line. Student repeats with correct rhythm.
Quickly fix the key pronunciation focus for this lesson.
Keep the student speaking more than you.

steps.title: Step 2 - Personalize It
steps.instructionEn: Complete the lines with your own information.

tutorNotes.text: Have the student fill in first, then read aloud.
Ask 1-2 follow-up questions to extend answers.
Encourage realistic times and tasks.

steps.title: Step 3 - Dialogue Practice
steps.instructionEn: Practice this dialogue with your tutor.

dialogue.en: Are you free tomorrow for lunch?
I have a meeting at 1 PM, but I'm available after 2.

tutorNotes.text: Do it once reading, then once without reading.
Switch roles if time allows.
Focus on clarity and speed.

steps.title: Step 4 - Free Speaking
steps.instructionEn: Speak freely using at least 5 sentences.
steps.content:
Include:
- Ask about one day
- Say one busy time
- Say one available time
- Use 'I have ... at ...'
- Agree on a time

tutorNotes.text: "Speak without notes. Try to connect your sentences."
Do not interrupt. Take notes and give feedback after.
Give one grammar correction and one pronunciation correction.

challenge.scenarioEn: Coordinate a lunch with a coworker. Ask availability, share your schedule, and choose a time.
challenge.scenarioKr: 동료와 점심 시간을 잡아보세요. 가용 여부를 묻고, 일정을 말하고, 시간을 정하세요.

guideQuestions.text: Ask 'Are you free on...?' at least once.
Say one schedule statement with 'I have ... at ...'.

tutorNotes.text: "Challenge time. Use today's patterns naturally."
Ask follow-up questions to test flexibility.
Success = correct key patterns + clear times + smooth flow.

discussion.instructionEn: Choose one category and answer the questions.

categories.title: AVAILABILITY
questions: Do you prefer lunch or coffee meetings?

categories.title: PLANNING
questions: Do you plan ahead or decide last minute?
How do you handle schedule conflicts?
Do you confirm plans by message?

categories.title: WORKPLACE SOCIAL
questions: Do you eat lunch with coworkers?
What do you talk about at lunch?
Do you prefer group or 1-on-1 lunch?

tutorNotes.text: "Now, a short discussion."
Discuss for 3-5 minutes.
Prompt reuse of target patterns.
